findings.message: globally scoped key-auth authenticated every route on 1.x; AI Gateway 2.x authenticates per entity, so it was dropped
findings.action: list every migrated entity under an auth strategy in config/auth_strategies.yaml

findings.message: config.redis.ssl_verify was false or null; forced to true because the AI Gateway 2.x data plane rejects a configuration that disables TLS verification
findings.action: install the upstream CA on the 2.x data planes; the data plane rejects the whole configuration (serving 404 on every route) when any entity disables TLS verification

findings.message: config fields llm_format are not part of the AI Gateway 2.x ai-rate-limiting-advanced schema, which rejects them; dropped
findings.action: check that the setting was a default; if it was not, the policy behaves differently on 2.x
